TDR plush badges and can badges excluded. HK Times Square Incredibles 2 exhibition pins (licensed, no pin-trading backstamp) excluded. Resellers (usshoppingsos, picclick, worthpoint, suruga-ya, k23japan, fryguypins) not used. HKDL Graduation 2019 / Chip n Dale 2019 pins posted late 2018 (noted in 207) not researched. Budget: 29 searches.
